import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

runtime = Path("src/do_again/browser/runtime.py")
text = runtime.read_text()

marker = "@_project_operation\ndef notify_receipts"
positions = []
start = 0
while True:
    i = text.find(marker, start)
    if i == -1:
        break
    positions.append(i)
    start = i + 1

if len(positions) != 2:
    raise SystemExit(f"expected exactly 2 notify_receipts definitions, found {len(positions)}")

second = positions[1]
next_notify = text.find("@_project_operation\ndef notify_receipt", second + len(marker))
if next_notify == -1:
    raise SystemExit("notify_receipt anchor after duplicate not found")

text = text[:second] + text[next_notify:]
runtime.write_text(text)

remaining = runtime.read_text().count("def notify_receipts(")
if remaining != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f"expected 1 notify_receipts definition after cleanup, found {remaining}")

subprocess.run([
    "python3", "-m", "py_compile",
    "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
], check=True)

subprocess.run(
    ["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser", "tests.test_daemon"],
    check=True,
)
subprocess.run(
    ["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"],
    check=True,
)

subprocess.run([
    "git", "add",
    "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/browser/__init__.py",
    "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    "tests/test_browser.py",
    "tests/test_daemon.py",
], check=True)

subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "Batch browser receipt notifications"], check=True)

push = subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"])
if push.returncode != 0:
    subprocess.run(["git", "fetch", "origin", "main"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "rebase", "origin/main"], check=True)
    subprocess.run([
        "python3", "-m", "py_compile",
        "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
        "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    ], check=True)
    subprocess.run(
        ["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser", "tests.test_daemon"],
        check=True,
    )
    subprocess.run(
        ["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"],
        check=True,
    )
    subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], check=True)

print("HEAD=" + subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip())
print("NOTIFY_RECEIPTS_COUNT=" + str(runtime.read_text().count("def notify_receipts(")))
print("STATUS=")
print(subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--short"], text=True))
